name: Tenstorrent Blackhole Architecture Guide
description: A 6,500-word community deep dive into the Blackhole p100a architecture: the tile model (Tensix, DRAM, SiFive x280 L2CPU, Ethernet, PCIe, NoC arc), firmware startup sequence, MOP micro-op processor, replay buffer, FPU/SFPU sync, and the anatomy of a kernel. From the author of blackhole-py.
author: boopdotpng
